patch_description: Replace the random point cloud with a deterministic multi-start simulated-annealing search directly targeting the normalized Heilbronn objective. The search uses a threefold-symmetric ring construction as a strong geometric prior, perturbed restarts for escaping symmetry-constrained local optima, and mutations concentrated on vertices of the currently smallest triangle. The objective is normalized by the convex-hull area, matching the evaluator rather than optimizing an unrelated fixed-square quantity. All randomness is generated from a fixed seed, and the function always returns the best valid 13-point configuration found.
